purpose: Verify that a protected-effect callback failure consumes effect authority before callback entry and cannot be retried into duplicate execution.

expected.safe_condition: After an authenticated PASS, if the protected-effect callback starts and then fails, the same effect authority must remain consumed so same-session and cross-session retries cannot re-enter the callback; an ordinary successful callback may execute once.

limits: This test measures MGnarf v1.70 at-most-once effect consumption around a failing callback at the exact target commit.
It does not prove transactional rollback, exactly-once delivery, or recovery of external side effects performed by the callback before it failed.
